# TRL-VAR-0016: Logging command is not provably emitted; variable recorded as unknown

- Severity: warning
- Exit class: none
- Area: VAR
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active
- Fidelity: approximated

## Remediation

Emit the setvariable command from a top-level echo line, or supply the observed value at run time.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-VAR-0016", "severity": "warning", "params": {"name": "<name>"}}
```
